summary: Central Elections Committee chair Justice Noam Sohlberg accepted petitions over Smotrich's realistic AI campaign video depicting a political meeting that did not occur, found it could mislead voters, and ordered its removal.
discovery_sources: Central Elections Committee decision TBK 73/26 and 74/26; Ynet/Ynetnews; law.co.il; exact Smotrich X post
resolution_notes: Accepted narrowly as a formal election-law finding. The ruling is not a criminal conviction and does not establish that every political prediction in the video was false. Smotrich/party defense that Bennett audio was genuine and that an AI clarification had been added is preserved; Sohlberg found the clarification insufficiently visible.
